regions.merged_text: JOY, PEACE AND GRACE BE YOURS - Better late than never.
regions.full_page: JOY, PEACE AND GRACE BE YOURS - Better late than never.
regions.per_polygon: JOY, PEACE AND GRACE BE YOURS - Better late than never.

regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your charitable favor. I succeeded To-day in getting Bernard's certificate off in the mail. By air this ought to fly over it .. Please tell Patrick our dear Brother I am not forgetting his letter - the one I Owe for his several weeks back. - just now "snowed under."
